ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black) pixel majority (~85-90%) with localized high-intensity (white) regions at the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous irregular white blobs are mapped to the far-left and far-right distal extremities; the central region and the majority of the lobes exhibit a uniform low-intensity black pigmentation with minor white speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, wide U-shaped depression at the center; estimated pixel angle of approximately 130-140 degrees with minimal vertical depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge boundary with fine, low-amplitude irregular serrations; increased topography amplitude and roughness detected near the lateral tips where barnacle colonization occurs.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve sweeping upward from the median notch toward the distal tips; the trailing edge segment between the notch and mid-lobe exhibits a slight concavity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, multi-tonal circular pixels (barnacles) are clearly detected on the superior-lateral corners of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, thin linear white pixel disruptions (potential rake marks) are visible on the interior black surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle encrustation on the outer margins of both fluke tips; scattered white speckling across the central low-intensity regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric white pigmentation patterns on the distal tips, with the left tip showing more complex, fragmented interior white mottling compared to the right tip.
